description: This file implements the WindowManagerHandler class and its nested WindowManagerNotification class, managing interactions with a window manager component, handling events, registration, and rendering status.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles window manager interactions, event registration, and notifications.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler::WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling specific window manager events such as user inactivity, disconnection, and readiness.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager interface and registers for notifications.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::terminate
methods.description: Unregisters notifications and releases the window manager interface.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::onEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events and forwards them to the event handler.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::renderReady
methods.description: Checks if the app instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for an app instance.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::WindowManagerNotification::OnReady
methods.description: Handles notification that an app is ready.
